== Summary ==
Original Japanese [[Trooper Davin Felth (Japanese)|Trooper Davin Felth]] from [[A New Hope (Japanese)]]. Card-face crop from [https://www.psacard.com/psasetregistry/tcg/company-sets/1997-decipher-star-wars-ccg-new-hope-limited-japanese/imagegallery/587873 Robert John's Japanese Hoth PSA showcase], [https://d1htnxwo4o0jhw.cloudfront.net/cert/156625012/jJJmjtHdhUuL3RV8TFx3SQ.jpg source photograph], PSA certificate 89673868.

Crop rectangle <code>(145, 620, 1290, 2220)</code> after applying the source orientation. Source SHA-256 <code>e7048c89f0635d937e32fc72b075b683195018771b90c9d0e14767eacb17e0bd</code>. Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc., 1997.
